headlines.headline: Fed Holds Steady at 3.50–3.75% — Dot Plot Still Sees One Cut in 2026
headlines.driver: For TLT: Positive — June dot kept easing bias alive; July hold without new dots left TLT's convexity unpriced, keeping TLT's upside if cuts resume in 2026.

headlines.headline: 10Y Yield Spikes to 4.55% on Hawkish Dots — 2Y/10Y Curve Steepens
headlines.driver: For TLT: Negative then positive — June spike to 4.55% steepened curve and hurt TLT; but created 4.6% entry for TLT's carry, which is now the theme's yield anchor.
